info.description: Backend API for IELTS Vocabulary Learning Platform
info.title: IELTS Learning API

post.description: Authenticate a user with email and password and return an access token.
Create a new user account and return an access token with the user profile.
Save a flashcard rating and update authenticated user vocabulary progress using MVP spaced repetition rules.

get.description: Return lesson metadata, topic and band context, vocabulary list, and authenticated user progress.
Return flashcards for a lesson with vocabulary content and authenticated user vocabulary progress.
Return quiz questions and answer options for a lesson without exposing correct answers.

post.description: Validate one selected answer and return immediate feedback without completing the quiz or updating progress.
Grade selected answers on the backend, save quiz attempt records, and update authenticated user lesson progress.
Create or update authenticated user lesson progress and mark the lesson as in progress when allowed.

get.description: Return due review flashcards for the authenticated user where next review time is due.

parameters.description: Maximum number of due cards, max 100
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Return the IELTS vocabulary roadmap with course, band levels, topics, lessons, and authenticated user progress.
Return topic metadata, parent band level, lesson list, and authenticated user progress.
Return paginated vocabulary items with optional search, filters, and authenticated user progress.
Return full dictionary-style vocabulary detail and authenticated user progress.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer " followed by a JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
